title: ACR Images, Tags, and Repositories
description: Work with container image tags, repositories, and manifests in Azure Container Registry.

data.text: ACR organizes images using repositories and tags. A repository is a collection of images with the same name, and tags distinguish specific versions within a repository.
The full reference for an image in ACR follows this pattern: `myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.0` where `myapp` is the repository and `1.0` is the tag.

items: Manifest: Metadata describing image layers and configuration
Untagged images: Leftover manifests from deleted tags

data.title: Docker - Tag and Push to ACR
data.content:
# Tag the image with full ACR path
docker tag myapp:1.0 myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.0

# Push to ACR
docker push myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.0

# Pull from ACR on another machine
docker pull myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.0

data.title: Azure CLI - List Images in ACR
data.content:
# List all repositories
az acr repository list --name myRegistry --output table

# List tags for a specific repository
az acr repository show-tags --name myRegistry --repository myapp --output table

# Show manifest details
az acr repository show --name myRegistry --image myapp:1.0

# Delete an untagged image to free space
az acr repository delete --name myRegistry --image myapp@sha256:abc123 --yes

data.title: Retention Policy
data.text: ACR does not automatically delete old or untagged images. Set a retention policy or use the cleanup task to prevent storage costs from accumulating over time.

data.caption: How images, repositories, and tags are organized in ACR
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    R[(ACR Registry)] --> Rep1[Repository: frontend]
    R --> Rep2[Repository: backend]
    Rep1 --> T1[Tag: v1.0]
    Rep1 --> T2[Tag: v2.0]
    Rep1 --> T3[Tag: latest]
    Rep2 --> T4[Tag: v1.0]
    T1 --> M1[Manifest]
    T2 --> M2[Manifest]
    T3 --> M3[Manifest]

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use meaningful tags like version numbers or commit SHAs
Clean up old images to control storage costs
data.takeaway: Organize images with repositories and version them with tags for reliable deployments.
